scope: Attack and hurt candidates derived from the owner-approved idle; no encounter or stats assignment.

references.role: approved identity/edit target and common canvas registration
approved native128 scale, pixel treatment and exact palette

poses.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE new ATTACK pose by reposing the approved Underhound idle in image 1. Image 1 is the edit target/identity-and-registration master; image 2 is the exact approved native128 export, a supporting palette/pixel treatment reference. Preserve this same creature, not a redesign.
Keep exactly four legs, the same long blind wedge-shaped head with no eyes, four broad clawed feet, one tapering tail, the high opposing rib structures, ash-brown hide and dull ivory teeth. Keep the same body proportions, pixel detail level, warm upper-left cue, cool dark shadows and native128 appearance.
ATTACK gesture: a grounded forward bite/lunge. Rear feet remain planted at their existing locations; the chest and shoulders drive forward and lower, with the front legs braced. The outer long muzzle stays nearly closed around a narrow opening. An INNER rigid tooth-bearing jaw plate slides forward visibly from that opening, approximately one third of a head length, down/forward into the empty space between muzzle and far foreleg. This inner toothed plate must read as a displaced structure within the same head, not a second head or tongue. The lower rib masses pull against the upper shoulder arches; keep a few strong broad masses rather than many extra ribs. The altered silhouette and weight should read clearly at 64px.
Critical alignment: preserve the SAME square canvas and absolute creature scale as image 1. Do not auto-fit or enlarge the animal. Keep the rear paws and planted near front paw at their original image positions, tail length and body mass consistent. A controlled low lunge, not a leap. Keep all art inside the existing canvas and leave transparent bottom padding; do not crop feet, tail or jaw. The idle's lowest planted paw remains at about 91% of canvas height. The shoulders lower; the body does not shrink. Leave the surrounding background genuinely transparent.
Production pixel art designed for 128x128 RGBA: crisp deliberate clusters, three shades per material, max32 colours shared with image 2; no new hue accents, smooth anti-aliasing, gradients, dithering, painterly grain, tiny scratch detail, motion blur, impact streaks or detached particles.
ONE isolated full-body attack drawing ONLY. No idle copies, pose sheet, background, ground, cast shadow, fog, blood spray, UI, text or labels. Do not alter the approved idle file; this is a separate new pose.

Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE new HURT/RECOIL pose by reposing the approved Underhound idle in image 1. Image 1 is the edit target/identity-and-registration master; image 2 is the exact approved native128 export, a supporting palette and pixel-treatment reference. This is the SAME creature, not a redesign.
Preserve exactly four legs, four broad clawed feet, a long blind wedge head with no eyes, a tapering tail, the same high ribbed back and opposing lower rib masses, ash-brown hide and dull ivory teeth. Same skeletal proportions, long head length, limb thickness, rib architecture, sparse pixel detail, broad shadows and warm upper-left light. No new anatomy, spikes, eyes or ornaments.
HURT gesture: a clear sideways/backward flinch from a blow. The head and shoulders recoil up and back toward screen left, the torso twists slightly away without changing its size. The NEAREST front leg (the one ending in the bottom-middle paw of the reference) folds at the elbow and lifts its paw close toward the chest. Keep the other three feet planted at their existing positions, supporting the off-balance animal. All four legs must still be unambiguously traceable; don't add a fifth leg or detach the lifted paw. The long muzzle mostly closes, inner sliding tooth plate fully retracted; no attacking jaw extension. Ribs draw inward with the recoil. Keep a strong readable change of body gesture, rather than merely changing teeth.
Critical registration: preserve the SAME square canvas and absolute creature scale as image 1. Keep the hind paws and far front paw in their existing positions and retain the common unseen ground origin where the lifted near forepaw used to contact. Because that paw is raised, the whole silhouette must NOT be shifted down to a new bounding-box baseline. Do not auto-center or auto-fit the pose. The back/shoulder can rise a little due to the flinch, but head length and skeletal lengths remain identical. Keep tail and all limbs inside the canvas with transparent margins.
Production art for 128x128 RGBA: crisp restrained pixel clusters, hard staircase edges, three shades per material, max32 shared colours consistent with image 2. Muted ash-brown/ivory/charcoal, no added hue accents or painterly detail. Transparent background only, no scenery, ground plane, cast shadow, fog, wounds/gore, impact FX, motion blur, text, labels, UI, multiple panels or extra poses. This is ONE isolated full-body hurt drawing, saved separately; do not change the approved idle.
